githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 2 adds a Friends view, Ignore support, native voice messages, and quick reactions. It also improves message sending, fixes Do Not Disturb notifications, and lets you install published pull-request builds from Settings.

## Friends and privacy

- Added Friends to Direct Messages, with Online, All, Pending, and Add Friend views, search, and live presence updates.
- Added sending personalized friend requests, accepting or declining incoming requests, cancelling outgoing requests, removing friends, and blocking or unblocking users.
- Added Ignore support, with revealable messages and profiles, suppressed notifications, ignored-account management in Settings, and warnings for shared group DMs and server voice channels.
- Unified user menus across messages, profiles, and member lists so relevant account and conversation actions are consistently available.

## Voice messages

- Added recording, previewing, and sending voice messages in DMs and permitted server conversations, including replies.
- Added inline playback with waveforms, seeking, playback-speed controls, and remembered listening positions during the session.
- Added a Record voice messages toggle in Features settings. Received voice messages remain playable when recording is disabled.

## Messaging and reactions

- Added quick reactions to the message hover toolbar using your frequently used reaction emoji, and an emoji picker for the Add Reaction menu item.
- Improved reaction layout beneath short message bubbles to avoid unnecessary wrapping.
- Added queued sending so you can compose the next message while earlier messages are being delivered. Pending and failed messages keep their place until confirmed, retried, or discarded.
- Fixed newly created group DMs appearing at the bottom of the conversation list.

## Notifications and Inbox

- Fixed message notifications and incoming-call alerts interrupting Do Not Disturb. Calls still ringing when you leave Do Not Disturb can notify you again.
- Fixed Inbox mention loading stopping on pages containing only hidden mentions, and preserved blocked-user mentions so they can reappear after unblocking.

## Build switching

- Added a pull-request build browser in Software Updates settings, with installation, updates from the selected PR, and controls to return to Regular or Nightly.
- Added a recovery copy before switching to a PR build, with separate settings and drafts for each PR.
- Added distinct names and icons for Nightly and Debug builds.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-1...v0.1.7-Beta-2](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-1...v0.1.7-Beta-2)
discordAnnouncement:
**Friends, voice messages, and quick reactions 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Find online friends, manage requests, and send a personal note with new friend requests.
- Ignore users to collapse their messages, conceal profiles, and silence their notifications, with reveal controls when you want to look.
- Record, preview, and send voice messages. Listen inline with waveforms, seeking, and playback-speed controls.
- React from the hover toolbar with frequently used emoji, or choose one through Add Reaction.
- Keep typing while messages queue for delivery, and enjoy quiet notifications while Do Not Disturb is active.
- Browse and install published pull-request builds from Settings, follow their updates, and return to Regular or Nightly.
